name: [5X STATS] SAITAMANIA [UPDATE 7.75]
desc:
📺 Inspired by the Japanese media franchise "One-Punch Man."

🗺️ An immediate danger has presented itself within the universe, bringing countless of enemies along with it!

❓ Could you defeat the swarms of threats before they take everything over?

☄️ Collect very powerful and unique character abilities to assist you with your battles!
📜 Complete quests to assist with defeating enemies, akin to Anime Fighters! 
✨ Level up and rebirth to further progress your character's evolution!

🛍️ Roblox Premium users receive a 15% boost to all farm yields.

🔔 Follow the game for update newsletters!

🛠️ Developed by CL Game Studio & 5iftyCent, - managed by 5iftyCent & robloxiandemo

❗ While SAITAMANIA is loosely inspired, any similarities are purely coincidental.
   We share no direct involvement nor ownership of Viz Media's "One-Punch Man."
